resolution: Frozen plan now contains exact method_root and controller_path. verify_plan requires their resolved values to match current ROOT/__file__, and requires every planned source path to equal ROOT/name before any child dispatch.
verify_plan reads the plan once for its SHA/JSON and reads each frozen source dependency once for its exact record. It returns verified_raw buffers.
Relay, harmless service data and WindowsJob modules are compiled/executed from those exact verified_raw buffers. Their loader does not reread same-named source bytes or consume pyc.
Caller probe and service executable scripts use the same now-bound ROOT paths. Their executable/source bytes are checked before dispatch and the original plan is rechecked per case and at completion.
Output remains a delivery location outside immutable method inputs; copying or moving the method input ROOT cannot consume the old original plan successfully.
Path isolation now examines decoded argv/environment strings, not their JSON-escaped serialization.
The predicate normalizes Windows case and slash direction, applies directory-component/text-list boundaries and checks private case/relay/service roots.
The caller's own initially empty cwd is explicitly allowed; it is not represented as service evidence.
The no_private_paths predicate is checked before caller dispatch and retained as the actual case check. ASCII service canary checks still cover caller stdout/stderr/argv/env independently.

unchanged_or_preserved: response_relay.py, receiver_probe.py and harmless_service.py have the same exact reviewed SHA as the initial review.
Actual separate probe blocks on stdin until EOF and reports its observed byte count and SHA; relay closes the pipe without a service-response write.
Service descriptor, original output references, callback exception text and relay results remain private controller evidence. They are not passed back to the simulated caller.
There is one service callback invocation site, with a second-dispatch guard in the harmless executor and no retry loop.
The actual exit7 case remains a normally returned service failure; a successful boundary matrix is not a service business success.
Caller and harmless service assign their specific owned Job before resume and retain their own close/finalization records. No whole-cycle success may be inferred from this standalone RESULT.

approved_finite_scope.purpose: A real separate caller receives stdin EOF and zero response bytes after one observed synthetic service callback, with original service byte/exit evidence retained privately.
approved_finite_scope.freeze_controller_process: One real metadata Python process still exists and must not be described as zero processes.
approved_finite_scope.process_census_limit: WindowsJob metadata-query descendants and the external parent controller are separate actual processes; the role counts are not a total OS-process census.

coverage_limits: This review executed no code. The four-case matrix has not been marked passed here.

Callback-raises, timeout, launch/assignment failure and cleanup-failure branches are not executed by the four IDs. MD now explicitly records callback-raises as unexecuted; exit7 cannot stand for that branch.
Closure of the two P2s is a source-level conclusion; no new copied-source or TEMP/TMP negative execution is claimed.

The method is a finite benign experiment, not a hostile concurrent-file-mutation or OS-security sandbox. Bound script-path execution plus before/after source checks is accepted; this review does not require a -c transport.
No real product operation/request, save durability, kill/power-loss recovery or old unknown operation is tested or authorized.
required_execution_bindings: Freeze a new original plan only from this exact reviewed method set, with the actual Python image and reviewed owned_process source pinned; consume its original SHA and exact source ROOT.

Use an explicit external parent controller that binds its own source/runtime/argv/environment/dependencies and records the entire controller Job. Natural success requires the actual attributed empty Job; controlled/incomplete cleanup must remain incomplete.
Review and bind the chosen WindowsJob implementation and any local non-standard import dependencies. This five-file review does not claim to have inspected an unspecified future owned_process source.
Keep the original plan, individual service stdout/stderr/exit, caller EOF evidence, service/caller finalization and parent Job records; retain any failure without retry.
A future product-service adapter requires its own actual operation ID/canonical request/command/input/output/full-observer binding. Harmless method approval is not product authorization.
final_integrity: The five current reviewed-file SHA values and the unchanged initial review SHA matched immediately before writing this new report.
